Public API: /v1/public/estimation returns {data, meta:{plan_id}} with X-API-Key, 401 without header or with 'wrong'; /v1/public/prices and /v1/public/calculators (paint) work identically. monthly_usage on db.api_keys is incremented (>=3 after 3 calls). KYC: siren='12345' → 400; siren='814152528' → 200 status='pending'; /marketplace/kyc/me returns dossier; /admin/kyc/review approve → status='verified', verified=true, badge='ConstruPilot Verified' and persists. Pro portal: /pro/me for unregistered user → {registered:false}; after KYC+approve → {registered:true, verified:true, badge, credits_cents:0, leads_bought:[]}. /pro/credits/checkout: unverified → 403; verified: 5000→bonus 0, 25000→1250 (+5%), 50000→5000 (+10%), each returning stripe checkout url. /marketplace/leads/buy with insufficient credits returns 402/400/404. Affiliate: POST /affiliate/click returns click_id; GET /r/aff/leroymerlin?url=... 302 to track.awin.com; admin/affiliate/configs returns 3 configs (leroymerlin, manomano, castorama); POST update ok; stats returns totals/by_supplier/revenue_eur. /api/prices/search 'laine de verre' enriches leroymerlin with is_affiliate=true, tracking_url and affiliate_disclosure present. Regression: /plans, /auth/me, /estimation/compute all green. Frontend UI (demo user is pre-verified per problem note): /pro shows pro-stats + pro-verified-badge + recharge-5000/10000/25000/50000 + pro-recharge + pro-tab-available + pro-tab-bought + pro-leads-grid (Leads disponibles list rendered with score badges). Nav shows 'Espace pro' link (highlighted when on /pro). /prix search 'laine de verre' shows Leroy Merlin row with green 'Lien partenaire' badge (data-testid=affiliate-badge-leroymerlin) — ManoMano did not appear in top results for this query (data-driven, not a bug). Admin: admin-tab-kyc + admin-tab-affiliate present; Affiliation tab renders affiliate-panel with aff-toggle-leroymerlin/manomano/castorama; KYC tab renders kyc-list with pending/verified/rejected/Tous filters. CRITICAL routing conflict: frontend route '/api' in App.js is UNREACHABLE via public URL — the Kubernetes ingress routes everything under '/api*' to the backend (port 8001) so navigating to https://<host>/api returns backend JSON {app:'ConstruPilot',...} instead of the ApiKeys page. All data-testid on that page (api-key-create-btn, fresh-key-dialog, api-keys-list, api-key-rotate/revoke) are therefore untestable from the public URL and unreachable for end users.

ui_bugs.issue: Path '/api' collides with the Kubernetes ingress rule that reverse-proxies every '/api*' request to the FastAPI backend on port 8001. Result: the ApiKeys.jsx page is completely unreachable from the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (returns backend JSON instead of rendering the React SPA). No visitor can create/rotate/revoke API keys via the UI.

action_items: RENAME the frontend route '/api' to something that does NOT start with '/api' (e.g. '/mes-cles-api', '/cles', '/developer' or '/console-api'). Update App.js Route + Nav.jsx link + any redirects. Otherwise the ApiKeys page is dead code — ingress preempts the SPA. This is blocking and must be fixed before shipping Phase 4.

Optional: Recurring React warning in console — 'Cannot update a component (BrowserRouter) while rendering a different component (Login)'. Not blocking but suggests a setState in render inside Login.jsx (probably a navigate() call in the render phase). Wrap it in useEffect.

Optional: /prix ManoMano affiliate badge could not be visually verified because ManoMano did not appear in the top results for the 'laine de verre' query — backend enrichment tested green so the badge component will render when the supplier appears. Consider adding a supplier-diverse mock/query used for demo screenshots.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/phase4.py public_estimation instantiates the API-Key dep for each call — good. But require_api_key uses `Header(None, alias='X-API-Key')` — fastapi treats missing as None → 401 message says 'Header X-API-Key requis', ok. Consider also accepting 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' for symmetry with SaaS conventions.
engines/api_commerciale.rotate_api_key raises HTTPException (a web-layer exception) inside an engine module — mixing FastAPI concerns into engines. Move to route layer or wrap.

engines/api_commerciale._check_and_record does the mongo find + increment in two round-trips. Consider find_one_and_update({key, active:true}, $inc + $set, projection) to make it atomic and race-safe under high QPS.
engines/affiliate.enrich_prices mutates the input dicts in place then also returns them — pick one style to avoid surprises for callers.

routes/phase4.py recharge_credits: product name f-string is missing a closing paren before the '+' concat producing 'Crédits ConstruPilot Pro (250 € + bonus 12 €)' — string still builds but the opening '(' has no matching ')' before the '+' bonus segment. Cosmetic but visible in Stripe checkout page. See line 235-237.
routes/phase4.py affiliate_redirect uses `quote_plus` while engines/affiliate.enrich_prices uses `quote` — inconsistent URL encoding; use one consistently.
App.js: /api route clashes with ingress — must rename (see action item).

rca of the issue: React route /api is masked by k8s ingress. Ingress rule: any request path starting with /api → svc backend:8001 (as documented in ENVIRONMENT SETUP). Because React BrowserRouter only sees the URL AFTER the server serves index.html, and the server never serves index.html for /api (it serves FastAPI JSON), the SPA never mounts on that path. Repro: open https://cmrenov-ai.preview.emergentagent.com/api in a browser → shows raw JSON {"app":"ConstruPilot",...}. Fix: change /app/frontend/src/App.js line 71 path to '/mes-cles-api' (or similar) and update Nav.jsx if it links there.
